title: AI Platform Engineer
description: Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it.What you’ll doYou will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running.Beyond that, your work will include:    Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.    Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.    AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely. You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it.You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms.What you bringA solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.You're comfortable with:    Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it    Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended    Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running    Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences    Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need toYou look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.Why Coretura?We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software.If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application.Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!Last application date: 4th of December 2026.Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.Please note we do not accept any applications via email.About our recruitment process  We are committed to a safe and secure working environment. As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate. The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation.A negative drug and alcohol test and an approved background check are required before a formal offer can be made. All checks are carried out in accordance with GDPR, and candidates are always informed in advance.Read more →

Un·e directeur·trice de travaux
=================================

Depuis 2012, ASV Construction Générale SA est active dans la direction de travaux en Valais. Membre du MBA Groupe SA, un regroupement d'entreprises spécialisées dans le domaine de la construction, nous nous engageons à offrir un service de qualité, personnalisé et à taille humaine.

 

Afin de renforcer notre équipe et d'accompagner le développement de nos projets, nous recherchons :

 

**Un·e directeur·trice de travaux**

 

**Informations clés sur le poste :**

* Type de contrat : Contrat à durée indéterminée à 100%.
* Horaire : horaires réguliers, du lundi au vendredi.
* Date d'entrée : à convenir.
* Localisation : Rue du Châble\-Bet 41, 1920 Martigny. Chantiers situés principalement en Valais.


 

**Votre mission :**

Vous pilotez l'exécution de nos chantiers, de la préparation à la remise des clés. Interlocuteur·trice de référence pour l'ensemble des intervenants, vous êtes le garant du respect des délais, des budgets et de la qualité.

Vos responsabilités principales :

* Planifier et coordonner l'ensemble des corps de métier sur vos chantiers
* Préparer les appels d'offres, analyser les soumissions et préparer les adjudications
* Assurer le suivi financier des projets : budgets, situations, avenants et décomptes finaux
* Conduire les séances de chantier et en assurer le suivi
* Veiller au respect des normes de qualité et des règles de sécurité sur site
* Organiser les réceptions d'ouvrage, les états des lieux et le suivi des retouches
* Accompagner les acquéreurs de nos promotions dans leurs choix et leurs plus\-values
* Travailler main dans la main avec les entreprises du groupe, qui réalisent une grande partie des travaux.


 

**Votre profil :**

Nous recherchons une personne structurée et autonome, capable de mener plusieurs chantiers de front sans perdre le fil et qui sait garder son calme lorsqu'un imprévu survient. Vous aimez le terrain autant que le pilotage, vous avez le sens du contact aussi bien avec le client qu'avec les sous\-traitants. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous possédez les compétences et qualités suivantes :

Solide expérience du chantier Formation dans le domaine de la construction :

CFC du bâtiment, technicien·ne, conducteur·trice de travaux, architecte ou équivalent

* Capacité à lire et comprendre des plans
* Capacité à tenir un budget
* Sens de l'organisation
* Aisance avec l'informatique
* Excellente maitrise du français (écrit et oral)Permis de conduire indispensable


 

**Notre équipe :**

Rejoignez une équipe polyvalente et solidaire, qui avance ensemble dans une ambiance familiale, au sein d'un cadre de travail moderne et agréable. Ici, la collaboration est naturelle, les échanges sont directs et la bonne humeur fait partie du quotidien. Le professionnalisme, l'engagement et la convivialité forment l'équilibre qui caractérise notre dynamique d'équipe.

 

**Qu’est\-ce qui nous différencie ?**

Au\-delà des compétences, nous croyons que le cadre de travail joue un rôle clé dans l’épanouissement professionnel. Voici ce qui nous rend différents :

* **Esprit de proximité :** Grâce à notre organisation à taille humaine et à une gestion de proximité, nous cultivons des relations solides et authentiques au sein de nos équipes. Les échanges sont réguliers, et l’ambiance de travail reste à la fois positive et motivante. Des repas et activités d’équipe sont régulièrement organisés pour renforcer la cohésion et la convivialité au quotidien.
* **Confort et efficacité :** Nos locaux spacieux et lumineux, associés à un équipement de qualité, offrent à nos équipes des conditions de travail optimales pour rester efficaces et concentrées tout au long de la journée.
* **Nos propres promotions immobilières :** Nous ne faisons pas qu'exécuter les projets des autres. Nous développons et réalisons nos propres promotions, du terrain nu jusqu'à la remise des clés. Vous suivez donc les projets sur toute leur durée, avec une vraie latitude de décision et la satisfaction de voir aboutir ce que vous avez piloté depuis le début.
* **Nos entreprises intégrées au groupe :** maçonnerie, fenêtres et portes, carrelage, une grande partie des travaux est réalisée par nos propres équipes. Concrètement, cela signifie des décisions plus rapides, moins de dépendance aux sous\-traitants externes, et des interlocuteurs qui décrochent quand vous appelez. Une différence que l'on mesure chaque jour sur un chantier.


 

**Information importante :** Les candidatures doivent être soumises exclusivement via la plateforme Jobup et doivent contenir un CV, une lettre de motivation, les diplômes ainsi que les certificats de travail. Les dossiers envoyés par e\-mail ou par courrier ne seront pas pris en compte. En cas de difficulté technique lors de votre postulation, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter au 027 723 23 32, nous nous ferons un plaisir de vous accompagner.

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Thailändischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (w/m/i)---Thailändischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (w/m/i)================================================nach VereinbarungThailändischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (w/m/i)================================================nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n:    Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören* das Sicherstellen eines authentischen \& neuzeitlichen Speisenangebotes unter Berücksichtigung der Saisonprodukte des Originallandes sowie das Erstellen der ükarte in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Corporate Culinary Director* das Kreieren von neuen thailändischen Gerichten und Spezialitäten* die Zubereitung der thailändischen Gerichte sowie der einwandfreie Umgang mit Produkten, Produktion\- und Kochtechniken aus Thailand* die Verantwortung der Einhaltung der Hygienerichtlinien sowie der Arbeitssicherheit* das Kochen in der offenen Showküche vor demSie sind ein ausgebildeter Koch mit langjähriger Erfahrung sowie umfangreichem Fachwissen über die thailändische Spezialitätenküche sowie den fundierten thailändischen Kochtechniken. Sie haben Erfahrung in der internationalen gehobenen Gastronomie und Hotellerie. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen Sie fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist von Vorteil. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind leidenschaftlich und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und gästeorientiert. Unternehmerisches Handeln und Denken zeichnet Sie aus.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.  Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.  Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.  Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.  Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     Auszeichnungen:      *Swiss Location Awards **«Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»***   *World Spa Awards **«Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»***   *LHW Membership Awards **«Sustainability Leader»***   *Great Place To Work 2025*   *The New York Times'**«52 Places to Go in 2018»***   *Travel \+ Leisure**«500 List 2021»***   *Handelszeitung**«Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»***   *Connoisseur Circle **«Best Gourmet Hotel»***   *MICHELIN Wellness Award **«Best Wellness Hotel»***   *GALA Spa Awards **«Best Spa Concept»***   *MICHELIN Keys **«3/3 Keys»***    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Lukretia  HR Manager  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen    ******jidcfa2c08jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

C'est pourquoi nous créons les conditions d'une organisation flexible du temps de travail, avec des offres de travail mobile, de télétravail et de travail à temps partiel.**Nous travaillons dans un environnement convivial**Les valeurs coopératives sont nos piliers. Ensemble. Les uns pour les autres. Elles façonnent notre manière de collaborer et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres. La culture du tutoiement favorise la proximité personnelle et des échanges sur un pied d'égalité à tous les échelons de fonction.**Nous vivons la diversité et l'égalité des chances**Nous encourageons la diversité des perspectives, des expériences et des compétences au sein de nos équipes. Cette diversité fait notre richesse et contribue de manière décisive à notre réussite.**Nous vivons une culture d'entreprise responsable**Nous mettons la performance collective au premier plan. C'est pourquoi, chez nous, la participation collective aux résultats remplace les versements de primes individuels. Cela favorise une culture d'entreprise saine, où l'on poursuit des objectifs porteurs de sens et communs, afin de développer ensemble des solutions optimales.**Nous encourageons le développement personnel et professionnel**L'apprentissage tout au long de la vie fait partie intégrante de notre culture. Nous créons un espace propice au développement professionnel et personnel de chacune et chacun et soutenons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs de manière ciblée, grâce à une offre de formation interne variée ainsi qu'à une participation aux frais de perfectionnement externe.**«Travailler et vivre sainement» devient chez nous un véritable programme**Grâce à notre approche globale «Travailler et vivre sainement», nous aidons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs à trouver \- et à préserver sur le long terme \- un équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée.**Avez\-vous des questions?**Pour des questions sur le contenu du poste:Sabrine Du Pasquier Responsable de groupe Centre de Service \+41 (21\) 612 50 32Pour des questions sur le processus de candidature:Cornelia Casasola Recruiting Partner \+41 (71\) 225 83 57**A propos de nous**jpid9951afajm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

Représentant commercial / Représentante commerciale externe
=============================================================

Vous maîtrisez l'allemand et êtes issu du domaine industriel? Alors rejoignez une entreprise spécialisée dans les solutions techniques et les composants destinés à l’industrie!  


Entreprise spécialisée dans les solutions techniques et les composants destinés à différents secteurs industriels. Elle accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets en proposant des produits adaptés, un conseil technique personnalisé et un service de proximité. L’entreprise se distingue par son expertise, sa flexibilité et sa relation étroite avec ses clients et partenaires. Afin de compléter son équipe, elle est à la recherche **d'un/e Représentant/e commercial/e externe** à **100%**.

**Vos tâches chez votre nouvel employeur**

* Vous conseillez et accompagnez les clients dans leurs projets en leur proposant les solutions techniques les plus adaptées à leurs besoins.
* Vous analysez les demandes et évaluez la faisabilité des projets ainsi que les produits et composants appropriés.
* Vous développez et entretenez des relations de confiance avec les clients ainsi qu’avec les partenaires fournisseurs.
* Vous organisez et participez à des visites clients en collaboration avec les représentants des fabricants.
* Vous assurez le suivi administratif de votre activité en rédigeant les rapports de visite
* Vous réalisez les calculs de prix et vous traitez les demandes spécifiques.
* Vous développez activement votre secteur grâce à l’acquisition de nouveaux clients.
* Vous participez régulièrement à des formations produits, salons professionnels et événements spécialisés.


**Vous offrez à votre nouvel employeur**

* Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation technique en industrie, idéalement dans le domaine de l’électrotechnique.
* Vous bénéficiez idéalement d’une première expérience dans la vente ou le conseil technique.
* Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et disposez de bonnes connaissances en allemand et en anglais.
* Vous êtes une personne dynamique, orientée solutions et dotée d’un excellent sens du contact.
* Vous appréciez travailler de manière autonome tout en collaborant étroitement avec une équipe.
* Vous faites preuve d’organisation, de flexibilité et d’une bonne résistance au stress.
* Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils MS Office ainsi qu’avec les logiciels CRM.
* Vous possédez un permis de conduire valable.


**Vous pouvez également profiter des avantages suivants**

* Vous bénéficiez d’une formation complète aux produits ainsi que d’un accompagnement approfondi lors de votre intégration.
* Vous gérez votre secteur en toute autonomie tout en bénéficiant du soutien d’une équipe expérimentée.
* Vous rejoignez une structure à taille humaine avec des processus décisionnels rapides et une culture d’entraide.

title: Responsable énergie du parc immobilier
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable énergie du parc immobilier --- Responsable énergie du parc immobilier ======================================= Entité organisationnelle Division Bâtiments Logistique Fonction Ingénieur\\-e ets spécialiste Code fonction 104020 Classe maximum 17 Corps Personnel administratif et technique Taux d'activité 100% Délai d'inscription Référence 7133 Description du poste -------------------- L'Université de Genève exploite un parc immobilier de plus de 200'000 m², comprenant des bâtiments d'enseignement, de recherche avec des infrastructures techniques complexes en sciences et en médecine. Avec un budget énergétique d'environ 18 MCHF/an et un niveau de consommation parmi les plus élevés du canton, la maîtrise de l'énergie constitue un enjeu stratégique majeur. Dans un contexte de transition énergétique, de tension sur les coûts d'exploitation et de complexité croissante des installations, l'Université crée un poste de Responsable énergie afin de renforcer sa capacité interne à piloter la performance énergétique, maîtriser durablement ses coûts et conduire la transformation environnementale de son parc immobilier. Votre mission ------------- À l'échelle de l'Université, vous pilotez la performance énergétique et environnementale du parc immobilier. Vous intervenez de manière transverse sur les bâtiments en propriété, en location ainsi que sur les bâtiments exploités par des tiers lorsque l'Université supporte les charges énergétiques. Votre rôle a une double finalité : maîtriser durablement les consommations et les coûts énergétiques et conduire la réduction de l'empreinte environnementale du parc dans une trajectoire de décarbonation. Vous identifiez les leviers d'optimisation, priorisez les actions, pilotez leur mise en œuvre et suivez leurs résultats. Selon les périmètres, vous pilotez directement des projets d'amélioration énergétique des installations ou en assurez la coordination avec les partenaires compétents, notamment l'OCBA. Rattaché\\-e au secteur Exploitation du Service immobilier de la Division des bâtiments et logistique, vous assumez les responsabilités principales suivantes : \* Vous assurez le pilotage global des consommations et des dépenses énergétiques du parc, avec un objectif clair de réduction des coûts et de production d'économies mesurables. \* Vous conduisez des démarches d'optimisation énergétique bâtiment par bâtiment, en propre ou avec l'appui de mandataires spécialisés, et travaillez en étroite coordination avec les responsables techniques --- Exploitation bâtiments. \* Vous accompagnez les utilisateurs, notamment dans les bâtiments techniques, les laboratoires et les infrastructures complexes, afin de rationaliser les besoins et d'optimiser les usages énergétiques sans compromettre les exigences de recherche, d'enseignement ou d'exploitation. \* Vous identifiez, priorisez et pilotez des projets d'amélioration énergétique des installations, tels que le remplacement d'équipements, la modernisation d'installations techniques, l'optimisation de systèmes existants ou le déploiement de productions renouvelables. \* Vous structurez les données énergétiques du parc, développez les outils de suivi utiles au pilotage, produisez des analyses techniques et économiques, appuyez la direction dans ses arbitrages et pilotez le suivi des indicateurs énergie et CO₂ et structurez la trajectoire de décarbonation du parc, en lien avec les objectifs institutionnels. Le\\-la titulaire peut être appelé\\-e à d'autres missions en fonction des besoins du Service. Titre et compétences exigés ----------------------------- \* Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation supérieure HES ou équivalente en ingénierie énergie, CVSE, thermique du bâtiment ou domaine apparenté, et disposez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins cinq ans dans l'exploitation technique de bâtiments complexes ou dans le pilotage énergétique d'un parc immobilier important. \* Vous savez analyser des consommations, transformer des données en décisions, conduire des démarches d'optimisation et piloter des projets techniques en environnement multi\\-acteurs. Vous êtes à l'aise à l'interface entre terrain, exploitation, mandataires, usagers et direction. Vous combinez rigueur analytique, sens des priorités, autonomie et orientation résultats. Une bonne compréhension des environnements scientifiques, techniques ou hospitalo\\-universitaires constitue un atout important. Entrée en fonction ------------------- 15 janvier 2027 Contact ------- Des renseignements complémentaires peuvent être obtenus auprès de l'adresse courriel : \[rh\\-dibat@\]() Informations complémentaires ----------------------------- Contrat : CDD de 1 an, renouvelable, sous fonds DIP. Lieu d'exercice : ensemble des sites de l'UNIGE, avec déplacements réguliers. Les candidatures comportant une lettre de motivation, un CV, les copies des diplômes et des certificats de travail doivent être déposées exclusivement en ligne en cliquant sur le boution ci\\-dessous "Postuler/Apply now". Aucune candidature papier ou envoyée par courriel ne sera prise en compte. L'Université de Genève offre des conditions d'engagement motivantes dans un cadre de travail stimulant. En nous rejoignant, vous aurez l'occasion de mettre en valeur vos compétences ainsi que votre personnalité et contribuer activement au rayonnement d'une Institution fondée en 1559\\. \*Dans une perspective de parité, l'Université encourage les candidatures du sexe sous\\-représenté.\* \[\](\< \>) !\[Université de Genève\]( ) \* Université de Genève Rue Michel\\-Servet 1 1211 Geneve \* \[\](\<\>) jpid287d530jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

propositions commerciales et techniques avec les spécialistes internes. \* Faire le lien entre le marché et les départements ingénierie, développement et service. \* Participer aux réflexions concernant l'évolution des solutions et transmettre de manière structurée les attentes observées sur le terrain. \*\*Réseau \\\& représentation internationale\*\* \* Développer et animer un réseau de partenaires commerciaux sur les marchés concernés. \* Identifier de nouvelles collaborations permettant d'accroître la présence de l'entreprise à l'international. \* Représenter la société auprès des Reconnue et incontournable depuis plus de 40 ans, Multi Personnel est une agence spécialisée dans la mise à disposition de personnel administratif et de cadres, temporaire et fixe, dans de nombreux secteurs économiques, tels que la banque, sociétés financières, multinationales, ONG, PME et institutions locales.

* xpérience dans une même fonction en Suisse

* Sens commercial, à l’aise dans la communication, les contacts et la négociation
* Personnalité ouverte, dynamique et positive
* Intérêt pour les travaux administratifs autant que pour la technique du bâtiment
* Maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants
* Bonne orthographe et aisance rédactionnelle

en gestion de projet et en suivi de chantier.  * Maîtriser les outils informatiques du domaine (SIG, Neplan ou équivalent, etc.).  * Faire preuve d'organisation et d'autonomie et communiquer avec aisance avec des partenaires internes et externes.  * Participer au service de piquet  * Posséder le permis de conduire catégorie B    **Date d'entrée souhaitée**  **: Mars 2027** **Un coup d'œil, sur title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description: Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen alsInternistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.Zuständigkeiten / HauptaufgabenDie folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.- Umfassende Betreuung:Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.Qualifikationen / Anforderungen- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)StellungQualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. title: Machine Learning Engineer - CERN
description: What you'll do:Help shape the future of healthcare AI, where innovation meets trust.At CERN, you will develop cutting-edge AI solutions that help prevent disease, improve prediction, and deliver trustworthy healthcare insights. You will work on technologies that make it possible to unlock the value of sensitive data without ever moving or exposing it, enabling collaboration where privacy is essential.As part of this role, you will help develop and deploy CAFEIN, CERN's federated AI platform powering major European healthcare initiatives, including UMBRELLA and AIM-SAFE. You will design advanced federated learning algorithms and secure distributed AI systems that allow models to learn from data across institutions while keeping the data exactly where it belongs.Recognised as a lighthouse example of "data stays, AI collaborates", CAFEIN combines state-of-the-art federated learning with CERN's unique strengths in trust, open science, GDPR compliance, and international collaboration. The result is a pioneering framework that is redefining how AI can advance healthcare while safeguarding privacy.Join us to build AI that learns globally, protects locally, and improves lives.Your responsibilities: - Develop and test federated learning software and algorithms.- Implement and evaluate privacy-preserving techniques, including differential privacy and homomorphic encryption.- Develop tools to optimise data ingestions and assess the quality of data and images.- Design and run machine-learning experiments using programming languages like Python with libraries asTensorFLow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.- Analyse data using statistical methods and visualisation for exploratory data analysis (EDA).- Implement and benchmark state-of-the-art machine-learning methods, optimising federated learning for utility, communication efficiency, energy use and scalability.- Design and deploy Internet of Things (IoT)-based federated learning architectures.Your profile:- Demonstrated experience developing and deploying federated learning solutions in real-world environments.- Proficiency in federated learning techniques, including aggregation algorithms, communication and network architecture, security and privacy features.- Hands on experience with network security, including certificates, encryption, access control, authorisation, and authentication.- Proven experience in coordinating or technically leading machine-learning deployments.- Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with software life-cycle tools and procedures (proficiency with Git and GitLab).- Excellent knowledge of programming techniques and languages: Python, deep learning framework (e.g. TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Jax or scikit-learn).- Experience in data analysis in a health care environment would be an asset.- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Machine Learning, Computer Science or Data Science or a related field.Your Skills: - Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.- Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.- Testing, diagnosing and optimisation of software.- Knowledge of best practices for developing secure software.- Administration of computing systems, upgrades, application of security patches, system and data migrations, backup and recovery.- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, taking action to address them; delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.- Cooperates constructively with others in the pursuit of team goals; balances personal goals with team goals.- Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.- Shares knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaches others to ensure knowledge transfer.- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Technician=====================================**About the****Company Description**AG is a Swiss engineering and manufacturing company based in Muttenz (BL), specializing in high\-performance mixing, homogenizing and process systems for liquids and semi\-solids.With more than 70 years of experience, serves customers worldwide across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, cosmetics, food and chemical industries, providing engineered solutions where process performance, reliability, hygiene and quality are critical.Our systems are engineered, assembled and tested in Switzerland, combining Swiss precision and engineering excellence with extensive process know\-how.In addition to equipment manufacturing, supports its customers throughout the entire project lifecycle, from process and engineering consultation to installation, commissioning, qualification support, after\-sales service and technical assistance.As continues to strengthen its technical and manufacturing capabilities, we are looking for an experienced professional to join our assembly team at our headquarters in Muttenz.**Role Description**The **Senior Mechanical Assembler** is a full\-time, on\-site position based at AG's headquarters in Muttenz (BL).The role is responsible for the high\-quality mechanical assembly, installation, testing and maintenance of 's pharmaceutical and industrial process equipment.The successful candidate will work independently from technical drawings, assembly documentation and engineering specifications to assemble complex mechanical systems and components according to 's quality standards.The position requires strong mechanical expertise, precision and the ability to identify and resolve technical issues during assembly and testing.**Key Responsibilities**Perform complete mechanical assembly of machines, process equipment and related components. Independently read and interpret mechanical drawings, assembly drawings, technical specifications and bills of materials. Assemble complex mechanical systems, including vessels, agitators, homogenizers, gearboxes, mechanical seals, piping assemblies and machine frames. Install and correctly position mechanical, pneumatic and process components. Perform accurate fitting, alignment, adjustment and mechanical setting of components and assemblies. Carry out mechanical modifications and adjustments when required during assembly. Identify mechanical problems, determine root causes and implement appropriate corrective actions in coordination with Engineering. Perform dimensional and functional checks during the assembly process. Ensure that assembled equipment complies with drawings, specifications and applicable quality requirements. Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and machine testing activities. Support installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting activities at customer sites when required. Perform mechanical maintenance, repair and refurbishment of existing equipment. Work closely with Engineering, Automation, Project Management, Quality and Service teams. Provide technical guidance and practical support to junior assemblers and other workshop personnel. Maintain accurate assembly and production proper handling and care of tools, measuring equipment, machine components and a clean, organized and safe working environment. Follow 's internal quality procedures and applicable GMP\-related requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement of assembly methods, workshop organization and manufacturing processes.**Qualifications**Completed vocational education or technical training as a **Polymechanic, Mechanical Technician, Machine Mechanic, Industrial Mechanic, Mechanical Assembler** or equivalent. Several years of professional experience in mechanical assembly, preferably involving industrial machinery, process equipment or customized engineered systems. Strong ability to independently read and work from mechanical and technical drawings. knowledge of mechanical assembly techniques, tolerances, fits, bearings, seals and precision mechanical components. Experience with stainless\-steel process equipment, piping systems, hygienic components or pharmaceutical machinery is a strong advantage. Experience with pneumatic systems and basic understanding of automation components is beneficial. practical troubleshooting and problem\-solving level of precision and strong attention to detail. Independent, reliable and quality\-oriented working style. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary technical team. Experience working according to GMP or pharmaceutical manufacturing requirements is an knowledge of  **and/or English**; ability to communicate in both languages is an advantage. Willingness to travel internationally when required for installation, commissioning, service or maintenance activities.**What We Offer**A key technical role within an established Swiss engineering company with more than 70 years of industry experience. The opportunity to work on high\-quality, customized pharmaceutical and industrial process equipment. A varied technical environment involving precision mechanics, machine assembly, testing, installation and service. Close collaboration with experienced engineers, automation specialists and project managers. Exposure to international pharmaceutical, biotechnology and industrial projects. The opportunity to take technical responsibility and contribute directly to the quality of 's machines. A dynamic working environment with short decision\-making processes. title: Lead Clinical Medical Physicist
description: The Paul Scherrer Institute PSI is the largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences within Switzerland. We perform cutting\\-edge research in the fields of future technologies, energy and climate, health innovation and fundamentals of nature. By performing fundamental and applied research, we work on sustainable solutions for major challenges facing society, science and economy. PSI is committed to the training of future generations. Therefore, about one quarter of our staff are post\\-docs, post\\-graduates or apprentices. Altogether, PSI employs 2300 people. PSI is a pioneer in the field of proton therapy. It conducts technological and clinical research to optimize spot\\-scanning proton beam therapy and to expand the range of indications for proton radiotherapy. In addition to its research activities, PSI provides a clinical program for patients with indications approved for proton beam therapy within the Swiss health care system. At the Center for Proton Therapy CPT, deep\\-seated tumors are treated using two gantries, while ocular tumors are treated on a dedicated beam line. The medical physics research program focuses on advanced imaging, treatment planning, and proton therapy delivery. Medical Physics Group and of the Therapy Planning team (therapy planning is integrated into the medical physics groups) \* Responsibility for the group budget, clinical duty service, working time monitoring and absence planning \* Coordination of the technical and administrative exchange of information across all organizational units \* Coaching and individual development of team members \* title: Linux System Engineer
description: EinleitungstextAre you ready to take ownership of world-class Linux infrastructure in a dynamic biological research environment? At the Department of Biosystems Science and Engineering (D-BSSE) of ETH Zurich in Basel, data-driven science meets cutting-edge engineering.As the senior technical anchor for our Linux ecosystem, you will join a focused, close-knit infrastructure group of four. Linux and storage service delivery is shared across three team members (with our fourth colleague focusing on Windows and virtualization). In this position, you will lead the core technical architecture and operations, while two team members work somewhat more closely with daily client and customer support. Underpinning our local setup are the central services of ETH ID, providing robust networking, central storage, and a growing central Linux core.Whether you are already an experienced senior engineer or a talented, motivated Linux professional ready to step into a larger role and expand your capabilities, we offer the autonomy and support for you to thrive. If you want your engineering expertise to directly empower groundbreaking scientific progress, this is your place to grow!Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungLead Linux Infrastructure & Services: Take personal responsibility for the technical architecture, continuous development, and 3rd-level operations of our Linux ecosystem, including hosts, web/application platforms (e.g., LAMP), containerization, and Slurm workload management.Automate & Orchestrate Systems: Proactively design, deploy, and refine scalable configuration management tools (Ansible/Puppet), database hosts, and automation scripts to ensure high service availability and operational integrity.Manage Enterprise Storage & High-Performance Data: Provide and maintain robust UNIX/Linux storage (NFS, CIFS, Kerberos, CEPH, RAID). Lead technical investigations into complex data challenges, optimize storage migrations, and safeguard data resilience.Secure Network & System Topologies: Own system security, disaster recovery protocols, and server/service lifecycle management. Define and enforce secure firewall rules, network configurations, and data integrity safeguards.Drive Strategic & Central Projects: Lead our local IT projects with high visibility and dependencies on central IT units, serving as the core technical liaison to deliver modern infrastructure solutions.Consult & Support Scientific Users: Act as an expert partner for internal research groups—advising on client/server specifications, delivering custom infrastructure solutions, and providing support for Linux workstations and servers.Foster Collaboration & Redundancy: Nurture team well-being and operational continuity by mentoring peers, building technical supporting skills redundancy.Ihr ProfilExpertise meets team spirit.You enjoy working as part of a team and value a service-oriented approach to your work. You are able to maintain a clear overview of complex issues and find it easy to get to grips with new technologies and customer needs. You have the following skills or similar:Professional Experience: A few years of hands-on Linux experience with strong foundational knowledge of Ubuntu and RedHat distributions, automation (Ansible and/or Puppet) and scripting, securing, and user-facing environments. Slurm experience is an advantage.Storage & Systems Expertise: Technical familiarity with Unix-related storage technologies (NFS, CIFS, Kerberos, CEPH, RAID), systems monitoring, and server hardware support.Virtualization & Services: Working experience with virtualization, container technologies, and web/application server security.Certifications & Growth: LPIC or Red Hat certification is preferred. We value continuous professional development and support your growth into the broader requirements of the position.Analytical & Methodological Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and a structured, proactive approach to system administration and planning, combined with a sense of innovation.Communication & Inclusivity: Excellent customer orientation, strong communication skills (in English, German an advantage) and an inclusive mindset for collaborating effectively within a diverse, multi-cultural academic environment.Wir bietenPosition-Specific Highlights:A role designed for professional growth, offering high personal autonomy and technical decision-making space.3rd-level systems engineering embedded within the cutting-edge D-BSSE scientific community in Basel.Strong team support with shared operational duties and opportunity to continuously develop your technical skills in a production environment.Comprehensive Benefits Package:Excellent financial security with attractive pension plans via PUBLICA.Public transport subsidies (SBB) and car-sharing options (Mobility).We live: Lifelong learningSee further here.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:Motivation letterCVWork and edication certificatesFurther information about D-BSSE can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Vernon Bailey, Head of IT Support vernon.bailey@bsse.ethz.ch (no application documents).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

title: Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering
description: EinleitungstextThe Chair of Geotechnical Engineering at ETH Zurich, part of the Institute for Geotechnical Engineering (IGT), focuses its teaching and research on foundation engineering, soil mechanics and natural hazards. Our objective is to combine theoretical knowledge with experiments and numerical simulations to develop new methods for understanding and predicting the behaviour of soils, foundations and infrastructure. We are opening a position in our research group at ETH Zurich, focusing on developing and integrating modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods into geotechnical engineering research, while maintaining a strong connection to the underlying physics and mechanics. We do not aim to develop a new AI model or replace physics-based engineering with purely data-driven AI. Instead, we want to use AI to transform the way research itself is performed—from numerical model generation and experimental data acquisition to analysis, visualization and communication.For this purpose, we are looking for a Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering, who will work across the research group, collaborating with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists.The role combines scientific research, computational engineering, research automation, data science and the development of reusable AI-enabled tools. A central objective is to identify new opportunities where AI can enable research that would otherwise be difficult or impossible, and to develop capabilities that can be used across the entire group.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungThe job will interconnect several different areas of our activity:Scientific AI and physics-informed modellingDevelop and apply AI and machine-learning approaches to challenging problems in geotechnical engineering and computational mechanics, with particular emphasis on approaches that combine data with physical knowledge, rather than relying exclusively on black-box, data-driven models.Explore topics including physics-informed and physics-guided machine learning, hybrid physics–ML constitutive modelling, surrogate and reduced-order models, inverse problems and parameter identification, uncertainty quantification, and AI-assisted scientific discovery.Apply these methods to problems involving soil behaviour, soil–structure interaction, liquefaction, natural hazards, foundations and infrastructure resilience.AI-enabled numerical modellingDevelop tools for automating and accelerating numerical modelling workflows, including finite element (FE) and potentially discrete element (DEM) and material point method (MPM) simulations.Automate tasks, such as model generation, geometry and mesh creation, assignment of materials and boundary conditions, parameter studies, high-performance computing (HPC) execution, model verification, extraction of results and standardised post-processing.Create robust and reusable tools that enable researchers throughout the group to build and analyse numerical models more efficiently while retaining appropriate engineering control and verification.Automation of experimental researchDevelop AI-enabled methods for the acquisition, processing and interpretation of experimental data from laboratory and centrifuge testing.Automate sensor-data processing, synchronization of different measurement systems, computer-vision analysis of experiments, extraction of deformation and failure mechanisms from images and videos, identification of experimental parameters, and integration of experimental and numerical results.Geotechnical data intelligenceDevelop methods to exploit the growing volume of geotechnical data available within the group and through external repositories.Organize and extract information from historical laboratory and centrifuge experiments and numerical analyses, and exploit large external datasets and research repositories such as DesignSafe and databases containing geotechnical and geological properties.Contribute to the longer-term development of structured, physics-aware geotechnical datasets to support parameter inference, model calibration, uncertainty quantification, identification of model deficiencies and the development of new physics-informed AI approaches.Scientific visualisation and communicationDevelop automated approaches for transforming research results into high-quality visualisations, animations and videos.Develop tools that support scientific publications and presentations while facilitating effective communication of research through websites, teaching materials, professional audiences and social-media platforms.Group-wide AI capabilityHelp establish AI as a broadly accessible research capability within the group.Identify opportunities for AI across ongoing research activities, develop common tools and workflows, provide internal training and documentation, and work directly with researchers to enable them to use modern AI and computational methods effectively and independently.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an intellectually curious scientist / engineer who combines strong computational skills with an interest in physical systems and engineering research. A background in geotechnical engineering is not mandatory but can represent an advantage.PhD in computational mechanics, computational engineering, scientific machine learning, applied mathematics, computer science, civil or mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline.Excellent programming skills.Strong background in numerical methods, such as FEM, FD, DEM or MPM.Demonstrated experience with machine learning, modern AI methods and AI-assisted software development.Experience with scientific data engineering, databases and the processing of large or heterogeneous datasets.Experience with HPC, parallel computing and/or GPU computing.Experience with automated simulation workflows and APIs.Experience with scientific visualisation and the automated generation of figures, animations or videos.Experience with computer vision and image/video analysis is particularly valuable.Candidates from other fields than geotechnical engineering with strong expertise in computational mechanics and Scientific AI are strongly encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will work closely with experienced geotechnical researchers who will provide the necessary domain expertise.Beyond specific technical qualifications, we are particularly interested in candidates who can bridge disciplines. The successful candidate should be able to understand an engineering or scientific problem, identify where AI or computational methods can provide genuine added value, develop a rigorous solution, and transform that solution into a reusable capability for other researchers.We therefore value scientific creativity, strong software-development practices, independence, collaborative ability and an enthusiasm for learning new areas.The position is particularly suited to someone who is excited by the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Wir bietenThe opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, computational mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Considerable freedom to identify research opportunities and contribute to the development of new methods as AI technologies and Scientific AI continue to evolve.The opportunity to work across scientific research, computational engineering, numerical simulations, experimental research and data science.Close collaboration with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists in an interdisciplinary research environment.The opportunity to develop reusable AI-enabled tools and workflows that strengthen research capabilities across the group.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:CVMotivation letterDiplomaReference LettersFurther information about the Chair of Geotechnical Engineering can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr. Alexandru Marin, Tel. +41 44 633 7370 or alexandru.marin@igt.baug.ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

title: Portfolio Manager
employer: Brevan Howard Investment Products Limited, Saint-Hélier (Jersey), succursale de Genève
description: The Portfolio Manager is allocated a defined amount of Master Fund trading capital and is individually accountable for the profit and loss generated on it. The role holder owns the complete investment process, from research and idea generation through portfolio construction, execution, risk management and performance attribution. The specific markets and style vary by individual; the expectations below apply to every Portfolio Manager in the Master Fund. It is a principal risk-taking position, not an analytical, advisory or support function: the Portfolio Manager makes the final investment decisions and bears direct responsibility for their outcome.Investment ManagementGenerate profits for the clients of the Brevan Howard Master Fund by trading the allocated capital on their behalf, within the pre-agreed trading mandate.Originate, research and develop macro investment ideas, building each thesis on fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, with particular attention to central bank policy, growth and inflation dynamics and their transmission into global rates, FX, inflation, volatility and equity index markets.Construct a portfolio sized to conviction, liquidity and correlation, selecting the instruments and structures (cash securities, futures, swaps, options and other OTC derivatives) that give the most asymmetric expression of each view.Deploy capital through directional and relative value expressions as the market regime warrants, including balance-sheet-intensive trades where the opportunity justifies it. Flexibility of style and the ability to scale risk into a strong theme are expected of a Master Fund Portfolio Manager.Regularly reassess that the portfolio reflects the intended market view, and restructure or exit positions when a thesis is invalidated.Take hands-on responsibility for execution, counterparty relationships and liquidity sourcing, and ensure that any execution delegated to a trade analyst or execution trader is correctly implemented.Risk ManagementOperate at all times within the risk framework agreed with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management: capital allocation, VaR and stress limits, leverage and balance-sheet limits, concentration and liquidity constraints, and the fund’s drawdown limits.Manage live portfolio risk daily and intraday, for the role holder’s own book and for any allocation run by team members, actively managing drawdowns and demonstrating strict discipline in loss management.Liaise with the risk management team who deliver risk reports, articulating positions, rationale and sensitivities clearly and responding to challenge.Liaise with Treasury to ensure positions are properly funded and that collateral is placed effectively.Improve and scale risk-taking over time as the investment process is proven, in agreement with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management.Performance, Monitoring and ReportingMonitor, attribute and explain daily, monthly and annual P&L and risk, and articulate performance drivers clearly to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and senior management.Deliver a return commensurate with the capital allocated, at a quality of returns (information ratio, drawdown profile, consistency across market regimes) consistent with the Master Fund’s expectations.Prepare periodic performance reports on a timely basis, monitor adherence to exchange and counterparty limits, ensure that all trading activity is appropriately allocated and accounted for, and maintain accurate records of the investment rationale for positions and decisions.Contribution to the Fund and the FirmContribute to the Master Fund’s investment dialogue, sharing views, data and expertise with the Chief Investment Officer, other Portfolio Managers and senior management in a collaborative manner.Where leading a team, take full responsibility for the hiring, development, output and conduct of analysts, traders and sub-portfolio managers, and maintain an ongoing commitment to their development.Present periodically to the investment management committee and, where required, support the Client Partnership Group with current and prospective investors.Governance, Compliance and ConductOperate at all times within the firm’s compliance policies, applicable regulatory requirements (including market abuse, conflicts of interest, best execution and personal account dealing rules) and the firm’s Code of Conduct; hold any regulatory certification the role requires in the relevant jurisdiction (for example the FCA Certification Regime in the UK); and act with integrity at all times. WORK EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND:EssentialA minimum of 7–10 years’ experience in a principal risk-taking capacity, as a trader at a sell-side institution and/or as a Portfolio Manager, Sub-Portfolio Manager or Pod Portfolio Manager at a hedge fund or asset manager, trading global macro markets.A minimum of 3 years’ attributable, verifiable track record of managing risk capital, evidenced through audited or employer-confirmed P&L and risk reports, with the candidate’s own contribution clearly separable from that of any wider team.P&L of a scale that justifies a substantial allocation of institutional capital, together with evidence of having run a large book and of the ability to scale risk as capital grows.A high quality of returns, assessed through information ratio, maximum drawdown and recovery, hit rate and consistency across market regimes, with limited reliance on a small number of outsized trades. Returns generated through excessive leverage, concentration or tail-risk selling are not regarded as evidence of skill.Experience of running directional macro risk through periods of market stress and drawdown within a formal institutional risk framework, and of operating comfortably at the scale and volatility of a flagship global macro fund.A clearly articulated, proven and repeatable investment process that can be explained from first principles: the source of edge, how ideas are generated, how positions are sized and risk-managed, and how the process has adapted to changing market conditions.A strategy and return stream that would be diversifying within a global macro portfolio. DesirableExperience as a lead Portfolio Manager at a global macro hedge fund with a multi-asset mandate spanning developed and emerging markets.Experience of managing balance-sheet-intensive strategies and large gross exposures, including funding, repo and collateral management.Experience of building and leading a team of analysts, traders or sub-portfolio managers.Experience of expressing macro views across more than one asset class, for example rates and FX together with inflation, volatility, equity indices, credit or commodities.A postgraduate qualification (Master’s, PhD or MBA) and/or a relevant professional designation such as the CFA or FRM. TECHNICAL/BUSINESS SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE:EssentialExpert understanding of the pricing, mechanics, risk characteristics and regulatory treatment of global rates, FX, inflation and volatility instruments: government bonds, interest rate and cross-currency swaps, futures, options and swaptions, other OTC derivatives and financing instruments.A sophisticated understanding of global macroeconomics, monetary and fiscal policy, central bank reaction functions and their transmission into financial markets.Fluency in portfolio risk measures (VaR, expected shortfall, stress and scenario analysis, DV01, Greeks, factor exposures, liquidity and correlation risk) and in interpreting and challenging risk system output.Strong quantitative skills, including statistics, time-series analysis and derivatives pricing; technical data analysis skills, with Python or a comparable language and Bloomberg proficiency expected.Detailed knowledge of market microstructure, liquidity dynamics, execution venues and transaction cost management in the relevant markets.Working knowledge of the trade lifecycle, operational controls, counterparty and collateral arrangements, and the regulatory environment governing trading in the relevant jurisdictions.The ability to articulate complex investment views, risks and performance clearly and concisely to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and peers, verbally and in writing.Judgement under uncertainty, intellectual honesty, discipline under pressure and resilience through drawdowns; self-motivated and accountable, and able to operate in a collaborative organisation with unimpeachable integrity.A strong undergraduate degree from a respected academic institution in a rigorous discipline such as economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering or computer science.DesirableExperience of building proprietary models, datasets and analytical tools, or of running a systematic overlay to a discretionary process.Established relationships with sell-side counterparties, brokers and liquidity providers
